Filed by user-tier POLYBIUS at the recommendation of the-stoa MAJOR_POLYBIUS in their Arc 25 standdown comment on stoa--p5g (2026-05-16T08:55:08Z).

## The N=1 observation worth accreting

Arc 25 Phase 3 produced a four-way convergent finding: ADA + VERA + CATO + ZENO independently surfaced the same P10 over-specification observation, with no cross-contamination (each ran against the diff blind to the others' verdicts). Convergence on the same observation across four checkers, where each one was free to surface anything they noticed.

Per substrate/operating-disciplines.md §6, the gauntlet's design intent is multi-checker redundancy — each seat has a different cognitive frame (ADA builds, VERA probes, CATO reviews, ZENO mechanically checks spec-vs-result) and the value comes from independent angles converging on the same load-bearing observations. Arc 25 is one empirical data point showing the property working as designed.

Per §15 (N=1 framing), one observation does not justify substrate canonization. But it does justify starting the accretion clock — record the observation here so future arcs that exhibit (or fail to exhibit) similar convergence can add their N=2, N=3 evidence to the same ticket. Per §6.7.1 three-condition gate, sustained-across-arcs evidence eventually justifies formal canonization.

## What to canonize, if/when N>=3 accretes

Candidate language: "the gauntlet's value is in cross-checker convergence on the same observation, not in any single seat's verdict." If three or more arcs show four-way convergent findings on load-bearing observations, this becomes the substrate-canon framing for what the multi-checker discipline IS structurally (not just what it produces accidentally).

## Cross-refs

- stoa--p5g — Arc 25 work-unit ticket (CLOSED at 2026-05-16; the empirical anchor)
- substrate/arcs/arc-25-build-directive.md — directive that scoped the arc whose Phase 3 produced the observation
- Arc 25 TIMING_LOG (commit 49b1dd5 on the-stoa main) — the-stoa POLYBIUS's structured retrospective
- substrate/operating-disciplines.md §6 (multi-checker redundancy), §6.7.1 (three-condition accretion gate), §15 (N=1 framing)

## How future arcs add evidence

When a future arc surfaces a similar convergent finding (3+ checkers independently surface the same observation), add a comment on this ticket: arc-id + which seats converged + what observation + load-bearing vs not. When N reaches the §6.7.1 threshold, file a follow-up to canonize. Until then, this ticket is the accretion store.

— user-tier POLYBIUS
